title: Finite separated collections preserve the weaker common quartic gap
statement: The supplied receiver reports that the new arbitrary-four-amplitude shared-mode block, retained triad and earlier overlapping pattern admit arbitrary finite9^j-separated mixed collections, with individual phases/output rotations/amplitudes and the uniform c/200 L4 gap. The single shared-mode block has the stronger c/32 gap. Sixteen positive cross-block estimates and the literal separation, not unrestricted overlapping-network composition, support this reported extension. The old triad-only5^j theorem remains a distinct earlier statement.
